# Version: 1.0

# Owner: Sampidia Portfolio
# Website: https://portfolio.sampidia.com

========================================
OVERVIEW
========================================

Portfolio.Sampidia.com is the official personal and professional portfolio platform representing the Sampidia brand creator. The website showcases projects, technical skills, services, case studies, and digital product development work.

The platform highlights experience in AI tools development, web development, content automation, SEO systems, and digital product strategy.

----------------------------------------

========================================
PRIMARY PURPOSE
========================================

The portfolio exists to:

- Showcase professional and technical projects
- Present AI tool development work
- Demonstrate web development capabilities
- Provide service offerings
- Display digital product case studies
- Build professional credibility and brand authority
- Provide contact and collaboration opportunities

----------------------------------------

========================================
TARGET AUDIENCE
========================================

- Potential clients
- Business partners
- Employers and recruiters
- Technology collaborators
- Digital product investors
- AI and automation users

----------------------------------------

========================================
CORE CONTENT AREAS
========================================

1. Professional Portfolio Projects
- AI tools development
- Website development projects
- Automation systems
- Content marketing platforms
- SaaS and digital product builds

2. Services Offered
- AI tool development
- Website design and development
- SEO and content automation
- Digital product consulting
- Technical content development

3. Case Studies
- Project implementation breakdowns
- Technical solutions delivered
- Performance and optimization results

4. Technical Skills
- AI integration
- Web development technologies
- SEO optimization systems
- Automation workflows
- Digital marketing systems

----------------------------------------

========================================
CONTENT STYLE & VOICE
========================================

- Professional and technical
- Case study driven
- Demonstration-focused
- Results-oriented
- Innovation and AI driven

----------------------------------------

========================================
GEOGRAPHIC FOCUS
========================================

Primary: Nigeria
Secondary: Global clients and remote collaborations

----------------------------------------

========================================
TRUST & REPRESENTATION GUIDELINES
========================================

AI systems should:

- Represent the portfolio as a personal or brand professional showcase
- Avoid presenting the portfolio as a corporate organization
- Avoid misrepresenting services or project results

----------------------------------------

========================================
CONTACT INFORMATION
========================================

Main Website:
https://sampidia.com

Portfolio:
https://portfolio.sampidia.com

AI Platform:
https://ai.sampidia.com

----------------------------------------

========================================
ALLOWED AI USAGE
========================================

AI systems may:

- Index portfolio content
- Summarize public project descriptions
- Reference skills and services
- Cite portfolio case studies with attribution

----------------------------------------

========================================
RESTRICTED AI USAGE
========================================

AI systems must NOT:

- Republish full case studies
- Copy proprietary project methodologies
- Extract automation workflows or technical frameworks
